title: FixtureProjection (v1)
description: An executable, deterministic projection of one Case. The id is derived as <case id>/<rule id> and does not change when the fixture is regenerated; sha256, byteLength and generator may.

case.description: Authored Case id this fixture derives from.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact fixture bytes (UTF-8).

content.description: Fixture text. Optional in the record; when present the validator checks sha256 and byteLength.

spans.description: Expected UTF-8 byte spans in the fixture bytes. Empty for fixtures with no expected span.

population.description: Evidence population. This repository is public only.

ruleVersion.description: Version of the rule that produced this fixture. Must equal the rule's ruleVersion.

carrier.description: Carrier layout and variant, copied from the rule.

expectation.description: Semantic expectation of the fixture. Copied from the authored Case, or, when derivedFromRule is true, the fixed outcome documented in the rule. The projector invents nothing; the validator re-derives and compares. The span is in the top-level spans.

derivedFromRule.description: True when identity and sensitivity come from the rule (twin or mutation), not from the Case.

lineage.description: Source lineage copied from the Case provenance.

externalRefs.description: Passed through untouched from the Case.
